critique.good: Stays inside the 360px box; column order and header row are recognisable; nothing is clipped.
critique.problems: Unusable. Rows are 1200–1600px tall, the table runs to 8323px, the description cell is a vertical ribbon of ~70 single-character lines, headers wrap (2/5) and there are 190 mid-word splits — Latin tokens (Excel, PMP), trainer names and the fee numerals all get chopped.
critique.cause: Giving الوصف 47px (26px of text) leaves room for roughly one Arabic glyph per line, so the 1420px of description explodes vertically. The remaining 313px were spread thin over four columns (120/72/56/64), so اسم الدورة at 99px of text cannot hold its 250px identity and also splits. Squeezing a table whose content is ~1900px wide into 359px is the root cause, not any single width.

critique.good: Readable: 0 mid-word splits, all 5 headers on one line, names and durations intact on 1–2 lines, row heights an even 199–246px, so rows still read as units.
critique.problems: Overflows the box by 356px (table 716px). Rows are still tall (10-line description cells) and the table is bottom-heavy; the fee column, the thing the reader compares against duration, sits 570px away from it at the far end of a scroll.
critique.cause: 230px for the name and 140px for the duration are generous — both would wrap acceptably at much less — while الوصف gets only 180px (159px of text) and therefore needs ~10 lines. The 716px total is spent on the columns that need it least and withheld from the only column that must wrap.

critique.good: The most legible render: every header and every name on one line, 0 splits, rows a tight 83–106px, table only 650px tall.
critique.problems: Overflows by 634px — nearly three times the box. الوصف at 400px is far wider than necessary (4 lines) and single-handedly makes the table 994px, so the reader must scroll ~630px to reach الرسوم on the far left, breaking the duration↔fee comparison entirely.
critique.cause: Widths were copied straight from the one-line measurements (250/168/105/400/70) plus padding. The description's one-line width is 1420px, so any value near 400 is arbitrary; 400 is wasteful while the total 994 destroys horizontal coherence.

critique.good: Headers all on one line, zero mid-word splits, and the name column (190) holds full course titles in 2 lines so row identity is never broken. Description at 196px keeps rows around 200px — tall but readable, and the fee/trainer cells stay intact.
critique.problems: Worst balance of the three: 631px total leaves 271px of scroll, so الرسوم is never seen with the row it belongs to. المدة at 92px (71px text) shatters '5 أيام (25 ساعة)' and '(بواقع لقاء أسبوعي)' into three ragged lines, making the short comparator column as tall as the paragraph column and killing its value as a quick scan. المدرب at 82px is the narrowest text column, so names stack under the tallest description and the row looks bottom-heavy with white gaps under المدة and الرسوم.
critique.cause: Width was spent on the name (190) and description (196) while the two columns a reader scans for comparison — المدة and المدرب — were squeezed to 92 and 82.

critique.good: The most legible and calmest render: 275px description wraps to ~7 lines, row heights drop to 129–176px, rows genuinely read as single units, and every word stays intact with no wrapped headers. The vertical rhythm across the table is the best of the three.
critique.problems: 711px total is the largest overflow (351px, roughly a full extra screen). Because الوصف sits between المدرب and الرسوم, the fee column is pushed furthest away — the reader can never see name, duration and fee together, which is exactly the comparison the table exists for. Name at 185 is narrower than description at 275, so supporting prose outranks row identity.
critique.cause: The description was allowed to grow to 275 without any cap on total width; every extra pixel there is paid for twice (once in scroll, once in distance to الرسوم).

critique.good: Closest to fitting the box (533px, 173px overflow), with generous name (170) and duration (88), headers intact and no mid-word splits anywhere.
critique.problems: The الوصف column at 130px (109px text) collapses into a vertical ribbon of one or two words per line — 16 lines, rows 292–385px tall — which is unreadable as prose and visually dominates the table while المدة, المدرب and الرسوم sit beside it nearly empty. It also still overflows, so the sacrifice bought nothing.
critique.cause: الوصف is the only elastic column; it was squeezed below a readable measure (roughly 2 words per line) to buy width for columns that did not need it.

critique.good: All four support/short columns sit at comfortable minimums — name 172 gives a clean two-line identity, مدة 104 keeps the duration parenthetical intact on one or two lines, مدرب 88 holds personal names in two lines without splitting, رسوم 70 is generous for a 43px number, and headers all stay on one line. No mid-word splits anywhere.
critique.problems: The row is a tall box with three small items pinned to the top: مدة/مدرب/رسوم float in 150–200px of dead white space, so the very columns the reader compares (duration, fee) are separated by voids and cannot be scanned vertically. The description still needs 9 lines at its tallest, making the table 1185px (nearly two screens) while also overflowing by 281px — the worst of both costs.
critique.cause: الوصف at 206px (185px of text) is the sole driver of row height: 1420/185 ≈ 7.7 lines. Every other column inherits that height with nothing to fill it. The total 641px comes from name 172 + مدة 104 + مدرب 88 holding roughly 90px more than their two-line minimums, which buys nothing vertically but adds scroll.

critique.good: Smallest overflow (217px) and the most compact total (577px), so the fee column is reachable with the shortest horizontal gesture. Name, duration and trainer all read cleanly in two lines; no splits; headers on one line.
critique.problems: الوصف collapses into a ragged vertical ribbon of two- and three-word fragments, 11 lines tall — unreadable as prose and it makes rows 222–269px, the tallest in the set, so the table is 1464px long. The ribbon visually competes with the trainer column and reads as a second, broken text column rather than supporting detail. It pays the price of narrowness and still overflows.
critique.cause: الوصف was starved at 168px (147px of text → ~9.6 lines) while اسم الدورة 156 and المدة 98 kept width they don't need past their two-line minimums. The width was taken from the one column that absorbs all wrapping and given to columns that were already settled.

critique.good: By far the best vertical rhythm: description 262 shortens rows to 129–176px, so duration and fee sit close enough to compare down the column, and the whole table is only 929px. Headers unwrapped, no splits, name reads in two lines.
critique.problems: Overflow of 331px — almost a full screen — and in the render the description column falls almost entirely outside the dashed box, so the one column that justified the extra width is the one you must scroll to find. Meanwhile the short columns are over-provisioned: مدة 102, مدرب 88, رسوم 72 and name 166 add width without shortening a single row.
critique.cause: Total 691px is spent on the wrong columns: roughly 40–50px of slack in name/مدة/مدرب/رسوم plus a 262px description, and the description is the only column whose width converts into shorter rows.

understanding.purpose: A course-catalog comparison table: each row is one certified training course, and the reader picks a course by name, checks duration/trainer/fee, and reads the description only for shortlisted rows.
understanding.reading: Right-to-left: the eye enters at the right on the course name (the row identity), then moves left across duration and fee for quick comparison, treating trainer and description as supporting detail. Scanning is vertical down the name column and horizontal only between duration and fee.
groups: col 1 (اسم الدورة) is the row header and anchor for every other column
col 2 (المدة) and col 5 (الرسوم) are the two short quantitative comparators and should read as a pair
col 3 (المدرب) and col 4 (الوصف) are supporting detail, read only after a row is shortlisted
keep_intact: المدرب names (55px words) — personal names must not split
duration units and parentheticals (أيام / ساعة / بواقع)
Latin tokens inside names: Excel, PMP
may_wrap: الوصف (1420px one-line) — the only genuinely long text, absorbs wrapping into 3–6 lines
اسم الدورة (250px) can take 2 lines without breaking identity
المدة (168px) can wrap the parenthetical onto a second line

bad.why: الوصف مضغوط إلى 130px، ما يجعل الخلايا تصل إلى 16 سطرًا والجدول 1975px؛ كما يظهر شريط يتيم بعرض 24px من عمود الوصف عند الحافة.
عرض الوصف 168px يفرض 11 سطرًا وارتفاعًا 1464px، مع شريط غير مقروء بعرض 22px من عمود الوصف.
الأعمدة الثلاثة الأولى مجموعها 356px، فتظهر شريحة 4px فقط من الوصف مقطوعة الحروف؛ رغم ارتفاعها الجيد، المظهر الأولي مكسور.
اسم الدورة 140px والوصف 204px يسببان صفوفًا من 9 أسطر، مع شريط 52px من الوصف عند الحافة.
الأعمدة الثلاثة الأولى 332px، فيظهر شريط 28px من الوصف بحروف متراكبة؛ عرض الوصف جيد لكن العرض الأولي غير قابل للنشر.
أقصر جدول لكنه يترك شريطًا 38px من الوصف، وبعرض كلي 728px؛ عمود الاسم أضيق من اللازم مقابل وصف عريض جدًا.

final.rationale: في جدول RTL تشكّل الأعمدة الثلاثة الأولى مجموعة المسح السريع: اسم الدورة والمدة والمدرب. تصميم r1B يجعلها تملأ العرض تقريبًا (365px) فلا تظهر شريحة مقطوعة من عمود الوصف، ويحافظ على وصف بعرض 275px يبقي أطول خلية عند 7 أسطر والجدول عند 906px. البديل r2A هو الآخر بلا شريحة مقطوعة، لكن وصفه 206px يرفع الصفوف إلى 9 أسطر والارتفاع إلى 1185px، لذا يبقى مقبولًا لا مفضلًا.

general: في الجداول القابلة للتمرير أفقيًا، يجب أن ينتهي العرض الأولي عند حد عمود كامل، لا عند شريحة رفيعة من العمود التالي.
عرض الأعمدة يتبع دور المحتوى: عمود النثر الطويل يأخذ الحصة الأكبر، والأعمدة القصيرة تبقى ضيقة؛ التساوي ليس هدفًا.
تضييق عمود الوصف حتى تصبح الصفوف 12–16 سطرًا يضرّ بالمقارنة أكثر من التمرير الأفقي.
أبقِ الأعمدة المعرّفة للصف معًا في العرض الأولي، واسمح للتفاصيل الطويلة بالتمرير.
specific: مجموعة المسح هنا هي اسم الدورة + المدة + المدرب؛ الوصف تفصيل ثانوي والرسوم قصيرة.
الوصف يحتاج نحو 250–320px ليبقى عند 7–9 أسطر؛ أقل من 200px يجعله يهيمن على الارتفاع.
الرسوم يمكن أن تبقى 64–85px دون كسر الكلمة، و70px كافية.
تجاوز r1B الطفيف (5px) يقتطع حافة عمود المدرب لا نصّه، وهو أقل ضررًا من شريحة 4px من نص الوصف في r2C.

final.tradeoffs: ثمة مفاضلة بين إخفاء الوصف خارج العرض الأولي (r1B) وبين إظهار جزء منه مع تمرير أفقي؛ بعض المصممين قد يقبلون شريحة صغيرة كإشارة تمرير، وآخرون يفضلون r2C أو r3B لعرض وصف أفضل أو ارتفاع أقصر.
final.uncertain: هل تُعدّ الشريحة 4px في r2C عيبًا واضحًا أم إشارة تمرير مقبولة، وأين بالضبط حدّ «جيد بالقدر نفسه» لعرض الوصف بين 250 و320px.

A.why: All five columns fit, but the description is reduced to a very narrow strip that breaks Arabic words and makes each row exceptionally tall. Course names and trainer names also split awkwardly.

B.why: The wider description reads better than in A, but it is still a narrow stack of text with very tall rows. The fees column sits partly beyond the viewport.

C.why: Course names, durations and trainer names are readable and easy to compare in the initial view. Rows remain relatively compact, although the description and fees require horizontal scrolling.

D.why: The identifying columns are readable, but only a sliver of the description appears initially. The tall rows leave large empty areas under the shorter fields, making comparisons across rows slower.

E.why: The initial view gives the course names, durations and trainers enough room to read comfortably. Rows are taller than in C, and the description and fees require horizontal scrolling.

reviews.unsure: The supplied views of C, D and E do not show the full description and fees columns, so their widths, word breaks and total scrolling distance cannot be assessed reliably. C is preferred provisionally because its visible rows are more compact.
